card.name: Object of 'effect of X on ...' phrases
card.fires_on: The word or word piece completing the thing affected in phrases like 'the effect of [drug] on [clearance/function/delivery]', or the verb right after it. It also fires inside the drug name in such phrases.

modes.label: Affected measure
modes.description: The body function or measure named after 'effect of drug on', such as clearance, function or delivery.
modes.example: The effect of progesterone on theophylline<< clearance>> is unknown.

modes.label: Inside drug name
modes.description: Partway through the drug name that sits between 'effect of' and 'on' or follows 'effects of other drugs on'.
modes.example: The effects of other antibiotics on the pharmacokinetics of sorafen<<ib>> have not been studied

modes.label: Affected thing
modes.description: The thing whose stability or labor is affected, ending the 'effect on' phrase.
modes.example: effect on the chemical and physical stability of the<< solution>> has first been determined

card.writes: It seems to push the model away from 'impact' and 'effects' words, since the effect phrase is already being completed.
card.plain: It marks the end of a phrase like 'the effect of this drug on kidney function', where the thing affected is named.
